text.heading: Turn Long PDFs Into Clean Presentations
text.supporting_text: Upload a source document, extract the key message, and build a polished PPTX using approved templates.

text.heading: Automation by the Numbers
text.subheading: A structured system for faster presentation production.

text.heading: Why Template Rules Matter
text.body:
Every slide has a defined purpose, character limit, and content format. This helps the automation write content that fits the selected layout instead of overloading the design.

The JSON library acts as the decision layer between raw PDF content and the final PPTX output.

text.heading: Controlled PPTX Assembly
text.body_left: The builder uses existing PPTX templates and replaces only approved text placeholders.
text.body_right: Fonts, colors, brand assets, layouts, and design elements stay untouched.

text.heading: Next: Image Replacement
text.subheading: After text assembly works, the next phase adds generated image insertion.
